entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Arihara made a post on[n]the Phan-Site.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He told all the girls the truth. And[n]he's giving back all the money he[n]took from them, too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't know how he'll atone for[n]the ones he hurt, or the ones he[n]drove out of school...
Sounds complicated.
No more victims, though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's not exactly the cleanest[n]resolution, I guess.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! That's something to be[n]happy about.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess this mission got me thinking[n]about the Kamoshida stuff again.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kamoshida was so popular. Even[n]though he was abusing his power[n]to get whatever he wanted.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: At the time... I felt like I didn't have[n]a choice but to go along with it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So when it looked like Arihara was[n]manipulating those girls in the[n]same way...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I dunno. I guess a little bit of[n]the rage came back.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kind of embarrassing, in[n]hindsight...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry about that.
Don't worry about it.
That's just like you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Yeah, I guess it is!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks, [fName].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm glad to see Lady Ann's happy. Her[n]smile makes everything worthwhile...
You can see her smiling?
It's just text.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wha— Shut up! I can see it in my head,[n]all right!?
